facts.fact: Aadhaar enrolment is free of cost
facts.quote: The highlights of Aadhaar enrolment are: Aadhaar enrolment is free of cost.

facts.fact: Go to any authorised Aadhaar enrolment centre anywhere in India with proof of identity and proof of address documents
facts.quote: You can go to any authorized Aadhaar enrolment centre anywhere in India with your proof of identity and proof of address documents

facts.fact: Common proofs of identity and address: voter ID (election photo ID card), ration card, passport and driving licence
facts.quote: Common proofs of identity and address are election photo ID card, Ration card, passport and driving license.

facts.fact: Process: visit the centre, fill the enrolment form, have demographic and biometric data captured, submit PoI and PoA documents, and collect the acknowledgement slip with the Enrolment ID
facts.quote: The Aadhaar enrolment process includes visiting Enrolment Centre, filling the enrolment form, getting demographic and biometric data captured, submitting proof of Identity and address documents, before collecting acknowledgement slip containing Enrolment ID.

summary: UIDAI Aadhaar Enrolment page confirms: free, any authorised centre in India with PoI and PoA, common proofs (voter ID, ration card, passport, driving licence), form-biometrics-acknowledgement slip with EID.
